## Passages
RESULT [attribution]: From the ar5iv version: on CIFAR-10 with flipped labels, TracIn self-influence recovers more than 80% of mislabeled examples in the first 20% of the ranking, while influence functions and representer points recover under 50% at the same point.
US [attribution]: It needs only the checkpoints and loss the trainer already produces, so self-influence of new-batch images (for example on the classification loss term) is a low-cost second opinion alongside ObjectLab for auto-labelled data. It inherits the single-run noise caveat.
CORRECTION [attribution]: None needed. Quote: 'TracIn recovers more than 80% of the mislabelled data in the first 20% of the ranking, whereas the other methods recover less than 50% at the same point.' NeurIPS 2020 confirmed.
